spec: Two 1px full-height vertical rules frame one wide column (x=88/1352 on 1440, or 32/1408). Line sits 14-23 levels off a light ground, 7-11 off dark. Text insets 16-24px. Horizontal rules bleed to the viewport at section changes. Rails pass through tinted and dark bands at lower contrast.

1200px frame with 1px side rails. Sections split into 2-up or 3-up cells sharing hairlines: no gaps, no floating cards, no radius. Cell padding 48px, cell height 0.7-1.0 of its width. Art sits unboxed and is cropped by the cell's rule. 64px empty spacer rows between groups.

Four 270px columns in a 1080px frame: five vertical 1px lines at x=180/450/720/990/1260, outer two solid, inner three dashed, about 6% ink. Lines run the full page behind content and through dark bands. Text starts 16px inside a line; cards snap to the outer lines.

Uneven full-height 1px rules at x like 48/160/1280/1392 or 64/326/1114/1288, 5-8% ink, with tiny diamonds, rings or 2x8px ticks where lines meet or start. Outer margins may carry a faint 8px graph texture. Content fits the column the lines define.

No side margin: 1px rules run viewport edge to edge, the page splits at 720 then 360, and each cell holds one thing. Radius 0, no shadows. Images span 2x2 cells with 29px inset or bleed to the rules. Rules take the section's ink colour and stop with it.

Four 300px columns with 32px gutters in 1296px, a 1px ink vertical rule centred in each gutter, lead story spanning two, 1px horizontal rules between stories, no cards. Or three 420px columns each opened by a small label over a 1px rule.

No centred max-width: 16-32px side gutters at 1440, 24 commonest, content about 1392px wide. Four-up at 354 pitch and two-up at 712 snap to the same edges as logo and footer, so the left edge is one unbroken line. Item gutters 12-24px.

Strict columns inside wide margins: three 376px columns with 32px gaps at x=124/532/940, or six 176px columns with 32px gaps from x=112. Nav, sections, carousels and footer all start on these lines, so unlike subjects still align down the page.

Full-width hero, then 2-up tiles about 702x580 with 12px white seams and 12px page margins, radius 0, no shadow. Tiles alternate pale grey and black in a checker so neighbouring images never compete. Copy centred at each tile's top.

1060px container: 360px label column, 700px content column from x=550. One short 20px/500 label per section, blank below it. Headline, media, index and form share the content's left edge; nothing spans across. 1px rule between sections, 60px padding each side.

Left rail 296-320px holds title, one line and action, top-aligned and often sticky 100px from top. Right column takes the rest (688-1024px) with any content type. Same split in every section, 1px rule between, about 58px padding above and below.

1280px rail, two columns, 64px gap: 48/48 heading at x=80, 24/32 lede at x=752 in 70% ink, text link 30px under, media 80px below and outdented 24px. 128px section padding, full-bleed hairline between sections. Same recipe every section.

Page divides exactly at x=720: paired 720px panels butt with zero gutter, and captions, footer columns and newsletter land on 720, then 360 sub-lines at 370 and 1090. Panels are image or flat colour, never cards. Optional 1px centre rule on a 16px inset sheet.

Media and cards start at x=32, all text starts at x=64, in every section. Card copy, headings and statements share the 64 line, drawing one invisible reading line down the page while images fill to the 32 margin. Three-up tiles, 24px gaps.

Section headings hang 140px left of the body: 64-80px heading at x=158, all body at x=298 running about 985px wide. Repeat unchanged down the page with 250px plain gaps. The outdent is the only grid gesture, so keep everything else quiet.

A 2px ink rule across 32px gutters opens each section. 52/52 title top left, 20/24 body pinned to the column's bottom, 681px media at right from x=727, 35px below the rule. Title and body sit far apart on purpose, joined by the rule.

Equal images centred on x=720. Captions right-aligned 33px left of each image; the right 500px stays blank for the whole page. Asymmetry comes only from captions, which sit against the image edge like labels on a drawing.

Uneven columns hanging from one top line: x=10/804/963/1201 on 1440, 190px gap after the bio, 160-240px between lists, 10-16px page margin. Or 300/580/remainder zones. Reads as an index, so no images or cards compete.

Let the viewport or logo set the grid. 900px divides 16/56/16/724/16/56/16 for nav, media and caption; or four 360x900 full-height ground columns, no gaps; or all text flush to the logo's width. Height locks to the viewport.

Mixed tiles on a loose grid: about 640, 305 and double-height tiles on 36px gutters with no row alignment, empty cells filled with a dot screen. Or four equal columns on 2px gutters, heights following the artwork. Reads pasted-up, for archives and brand feeds.

The page is a visible table on pale grey: 1px mid-grey lines, 40px number column, 320px name column, then 80px cells, 19px rows, no margins, cards or sections; spacer rows divide groups. For rosters and programmes where the data is the design.

Full-bleed bands alternate the page ground and a 2-4% tint, 96-120px padding, same rail inside, rails and guides unbroken across the change, optional 1px hairline. Cards take the opposite tone of their band. Contrast stays low so the page reads as continuous.

One ground from nav to footer, no dividers or tints. 160-240px of empty page between dense, hairline-carded modules. Hierarchy comes only from type size. Pages can run 14,000px without feeling crowded, provided the modules themselves are tight.

One unit repeats identically and replaces section headings: 1px rule, 100px clear, label, claim, body, plate. Or 400px cover, 20px gap, 36px title, 16px gap, 24px author row, 66px gap. Or photo, 70px gap, 63px paragraph, link, 2px rule, 66px gap.

Long light runs broken by an edge-to-edge black block at least one viewport tall (about 950px), dense with product, no gradient at the boundary. Fixed nav flips colour exactly at the cut. Most pages use one block, 25-50% of the way down.

Full-bleed flat grounds butt with no gutter, gradient or rule. Each 500-700px block holds one headline, one product, one action. Five to seven grounds from one limited set. Images may overlap seams. The colour change is the only divider.

The whole page changes ground and ink per chapter, each a designed colourway such as slate on pale blue or red-orange on peach. Scroll crossfades between rooms, cards stay one constant off-white. Four or five rooms at most, long-form reports only.

Sections meet on 40-80px radii: each colour's bottom corners round over the next, using z-index and a negative top margin equal to the radius. No straight edge wherever colour changes. Contents must change shape per sheet, never a left-right zig-zag.

Two widths alternate on one axis: 1392px edge panels and 1184px contained blocks, radius 16. About 120px between chapters, only 24px between stacked panels so related panels fuse. No full-bleed bands; the page reads as stacked plates.

A 1024px column steps through one full panel, then two 500px panels, then three 325px text panels, 24px gaps, each group opened by a centred H2 with 120px above. Shape changes while fill and radius never do.

Each screen is a 100vh full-bleed image with one title and at most one action. No section padding, headings or body copy. Scenes butt with zero gap, or rest on 270px white bands. Whole site may be only 3,000-5,000px tall.

A one-sentence or wordless row splits product modules: 112/115 three-line statement, left aligned, 150px above and below; or a 320px row of objects restating the motif. Use once or twice, so the page reads as an argument, not a feature list.
Dark and light sections meet on a shallow elliptical arc, 14px rise across 1000px, one clip-path curve reused at every colour change. Keep it barely visible; a deeper curve reads as a 2016 template.

Secondary plan families collapse to 56px headings with a plus, about 266px tall between full-bleed hairlines; heading takes the accent on hover. Keeps a pricing page short while the whole catalogue stays scannable.

One 580-640px column on an empty page, no nav bar, cards or rules. 100-170px above the first line, 55-80px between groups, about 90% plain ground. Gaps alone separate identity, statement and record, so type must be excellent.

Plain ground, one image per viewport and 60-66% empty, 120-260px between objects, no dividers or tints, at most one caption per screen. Margins stay blank for the whole scroll so photographs read as hung on a wall.

Document height equals the viewport. Everything sits on one axis or in one 856px column, 250-317px clear around the centre group, link rows 45px from top and 58px from bottom. No logos, stats or sections; depth lives behind links.
All UI pinned to the edges of an empty field: wordmark top left, timestamp top centre, small mark top right, 12px blurb bottom left. The centre stays empty for one live object.
Each scroll stop holds one centred element on a plain ground, about 200px vertical gaps, over 60% empty, central column about 430px, optional anchors at 35px margins. No rules, tints or cards.

One short 20px/500 label per section in a 360px left column that otherwise stays blank down the page, leaving a third of the container empty. The void is structural and constant, reading like a printed index.

In a tall text panel use only the lowest third: 13px paragraph, headline, small thumbnail, action, all bottom aligned, upper two thirds plain, so emptiness matches the neighbouring photo's area. Or tall cells with title at top, 140px gap, images on a shared base.

One 14px centred line at y=270, 12px grey line 30px below, then 300px of nothing before 870px-wide imagery. The contrast is 14px type against full-width images. No display headline anywhere on the first screen.

Between long runs, one near-empty viewport: a single title or three-line heading with 380-600px empty around it, no chrome. Works as a breath before a finale or between projects. Two or three on a page at most.

Ordinary sections on wide air: 96-160px between sections, 120px around centred 500px intros, side margins 40-133px, no cards, borders or tints. Hierarchy from size and hairlines. One canvas from nav to footer, bookended by a dark strip.

Viewport splits 40/60 on a 1px rule. Left panel stays fixed with logo, headline, actions and footer links; right column scrolls as a document. Panel needs a resident object. Also 50/50 colour panel with scrolling plates, or 1044px canvas with 348px side sheet.

Images never share a row: two 580px images with tops offset 180px, then widths change to 553, 453 and 933 centred, left edges stepping x=100, 760, 252. Gaps 120-200px, caption under each. Two objects per viewport for commerce, one for a gallery.

Each section changes which edge the photo bleeds from: widths 700, 852, 816, or 42% of the viewport, with the text's left edge jumping to match and 260px of ground between. Photos start partway down the previous block, so the page descends as a staircase.

706px image and 660px flat panel overlap: panel starts 65px below the image top and covers its right edge, with a stepped tab on one top corner. Rows swap sides. Hard corners, no shadow. Or photos hanging 290px past offset colour blocks.

An image or card row starts on one ground and overlaps about 140px into the next, offset from the copy column. It joins two sections and gives depth with no shadow. A first card row can rise 40px over a hero's bottom edge.

Section boundary is a 6-degree slope from tint to white, no rule. At the right edge flat accent parallelograms ride the cut and overlap, mixing where they cross, echoing the hero quietly. Once or twice on a page.

Section flips to black: left half a 40px grey caps statement, right half two offset photo columns, radius 8, scrolling at different speeds, leaving staggered bottom edges against the light section below.

Headline at the left 32px margin and action at the right 32px margin, on one horizontal axis at y=450 of a full-bleed image. The subject fills the span between. The same layout repeats on every screen.

The site is the product's own shell. Document locked to the viewport: menu bar, icon columns, 1140x800 24px-radius window scrolling inside. Or one pitch card, then the real feed for 4000px with the pitch returning mid-feed. Needs a product with a personality.

Overlapping photos, a 45-degree hatch block and small data tiles above; essay column below starts off-centre at x=644, 36px heading over 18/27 text. The collage breaks the grid once so the essay can stay strict.
Cards from 216x114 to 570x380 on a strong ground, 20px gaps, ragged left edges at five x positions, a stepped silhouette like posters on a wall. Every card is a link. For clubs, venues and culture.

The page's only saturated field: full bleed, one viewport tall, 64px two-line sentence bottom left, nothing else. Add grain or a dissolving edge and let dark product shots overlap its top and bottom edges, or it reads as a flat poster.

One full-bleed dark room in a light page: deep ground with two soft colour glows, 48px heading, tinted lede, 640px panel, 24px radius, 1px tinted border, caps labels. For trust, privacy and security. Surfaces step up inside; type system stays the same.

Chapter starts on a 6-degree edge, clip-path with a 10.5vw rise. Two or three flat strips ride the cut at the right and overlap. Accent switches for this chapter; panels raise one step with a 1px border. Without the strips it reads as a 2014 template.

Edge-to-edge panel cut by a 60-degree diagonal: deep ground to black at left, white to grey at right. Two products overlap the cut, 47px/500 names at opposite sides, underlined actions. For comparing exactly two things.

Full-bleed section with a non-straight top: left third rises 80px, centre recessed, right third 20px higher, hard 90-degree steps at x=326 and x=1070. Replaces any wave or gradient. Repeat the step in panels so it is a system.

Edge-to-edge still on black between light sections, no card or overlay gradient; white 45px headline left, small text in a right column. Or 100vh scenes stacked on hard cuts, both images sharing a ground so the seam stays calm.

Full-bleed photo pinned at 100vh while a 770px flat card scrolls up over it, holding small eyebrow, 40px heading, lede, action and a second image. Text never sits on the photo. Hold for one or two viewports.

Dark chapters are sheets, not bands: 1416px wide, 12px margins on a pale page, radius 20, inner panels one step lighter with radius 20. Light and dark overlap as stacked cards with no hard horizontal seam.
White page, 15px frame, 56px header row and 60px footer row hold all text; one 1410x780 photo fills between. Page height equals the viewport, so nothing scrolls away.
A 1360x698 photo, radius 8, centred across the join between a colour band and the page, the band ending 40% down the image. Gives the colour change depth without shadows.

One centred 580-640px column for everything: bio, rows, media. On 1440 that is x=400-1040. Index rows split it into three columns at 224 pitch. Optional 1px dashed side rules and 48px inner padding. Pages often under 1600px tall.

One width for all chrome and content: 896, 980, 1046 or 1300px. Nav, cards, tables, FAQ and footer hit the same two x positions; bands change colour but content edges never move. Optional 1px boxed side rails. This constancy produces the calm.
Up to four widths on one centre axis, stepping with reading density: nav 1084, pricing 1200, FAQ 944, switch 672. Or a 1024 frame with a 672 measure sharing a left edge. Wide is about 2.2x narrow.

All text and rails start at x=230 on a 980px column. Galleries start on that line and bleed only rightward past the viewport, scrolling sideways, so the left edge stays one line down the page. The next image peeks in to signal scroll.
Primary content runs the full viewport inside 16px margins with hairlines margin to margin; labels and secondary blocks indent to x=134. That second axis gives structure without any container.

Content column x=469-1232 sits right of centre, balanced by a date rail in the left third. Title, cover, heading and author share one left edge; search aligns to the right edge. Nothing breaks the column.

Shell in a 2-3% tint; 56px header and 260px sidebar sit directly on it. White content pane, radius 16, 1px line, inset 8px from right and bottom, scrolling inside. Article measure 672px. The article reads as a raised sheet.
1000px column of flat blocks on 10px gaps: 60px header strip, bio panel, five rows, action panel, one-line footer. The whole site nearly fits one viewport at about 950px tall.

Fixed 924px column centred on pure black with 258px empty gutters at 1440, no fluid scaling. Surfaces step #000, #0c0c0c, #0e0e0e, #151515. Dates the layout on purpose; for archives and culture sites.
